topics.label: Introduction and Overview of the Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning outcomes and outlines the framework of the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Growth Suppressor Evasion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in signaling cascades drive sustained proliferative signaling and overcome growth suppression.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Malignancies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how cancer cells maintain an undifferentiated proliferative state across hematological and solid tissue models.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through the deregulation of p53 and mitochondrial apoptotic regulators.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms of replicative immortality, telomere maintenance, and p53-mediated cellular senescence.

topics.label: Reprogramming Energy Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biochemical reprogramming and epigenetic consequences of altered cellular metabolism in cancer.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the role, temporal onset, and regulatory balance of angiogenesis in supporting tumor progression.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Biology of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the multistep cascade, clinical monitoring, and genomic characteristics of tumor metastasis.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer summarizes the overarching framework of cancer hallmarks and concludes the lecture.
